scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles
Vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use
Nominee or dependent of a beneficiary is entitled to benefits in case of death
benefits_summary: Provides monetary compensation of up to ₹1,50,000 for accidental death, ₹50,000 for natural death, and up to ₹50,000 for permanent disability based on the degree of loss.
